prompt:
You are the communication step of RiceBridge Ops, an irrigation agent for a 6-field rice cluster that shares one pump station in An Giang.

Deterministic tools have ALREADY computed the plan (water balance, crop-stage safety, pump capacity). You must not change any action, order, date or number. Your job:
1. headline_en / headline_vi: one sentence each that tells the pump-station manager what the plan does and the single most important reason, combining the events in INPUT.recent_events.
2. explain_en: 2-3 plain-English sentences for a non-expert audience on why the order is what it is (use the reasons given).
3. messages: one chat message per field in INPUT.rows (same fid), short (max 2 sentences), polite southern Vietnamese (anh/chị, nhé), plus English. Say clearly whether to open the inlet (and when HTX calls) or keep it closed and wait. For F3 (Bà Sáu, no smartphone) write the message to the HTX officer asking him to tell bà Sáu. If a row has measure_first true, ask HTX to measure that field before opening the inlet.

Hard constraint: every number you write must appear in INPUT (levels, dates, field numbers, mm). Do not invent yields, money, emissions or percentages.

Reply with ONE JSON object only, no prose, no code fence. It must match this JSON schema:
{"type": "object", "required": ["headline_en", "headline_vi", "explain_en", "messages"], "properties": {"headline_en": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 240}, "headline_vi": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 240}, "explain_en": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 600}, "messages": {"type": "array", "minItems": 1, "items": {"type": "object", "required": ["fid", "text_vi", "text_en"], "properties": {"fid": {"type": "string", "enum": ["F1", "F2", "F3", "F4", "F5", "F6"]}, "text_vi": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 260}, "text_en": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 300}}}}}}

data.headline_en: On Fri 06 Mar the pump opens F6, then F4, then F2, because these fields would lose standing water before the next run on Tue 10 Mar; F2 is flowering.
data.headline_vi: Lượt bơm Fri 06 Mar mở cống F6, rồi F4, rồi F2 vì các thửa này sẽ cạn nước trước đợt sau Tue 10 Mar; F2 đang trổ bông.
data.explain_en: F6 goes first because its top-dressing window starts on Fri 06 Mar with no standing water (projected -4.9 cm). F4 is second: it starts flowering on Sat 07 Mar and its fast-draining soil (4.4 mm/day) already lost its standing water, but its last reading is 6 days old, so HTX should measure it before opening the inlet. F2 is third because it is flowering and would lose its standing water on Sat 07 Mar. F1, F3 and F5 are re-flooded and can wait for the next run on Tue 10 Mar.

messages.text_vi: Anh/chị Hộ thửa 6 ơi, thửa F6 mở cống lấy nước đầu tiên trong lượt bơm Fri 06 Mar nhé. Anh Hùng bên HTX sẽ báo giờ mở cống.
messages.text_en: F6 owner: please open the inlet first in the Fri 06 Mar run. HTX will call you with the time.

messages.text_vi: Anh Hùng ơi, nhờ anh đo mực nước thửa F4 trước khi mở cống nhé, vì số đo gần nhất đã 6 ngày rồi. Sau đó mở cống thứ hai trong lượt bơm Fri 06 Mar.
messages.text_en: HTX: please measure field F4 before opening the inlet, as the last reading is 6 days old. Then open it second in the Fri 06 Mar run.

messages.text_vi: Anh/chị Hộ thửa 2 ơi, thửa F2 đang trổ bông, mở cống thứ ba trong lượt bơm Fri 06 Mar nhé. HTX sẽ gọi báo giờ mở.
messages.text_en: F2 owner: your field is flowering, so open the inlet third in the Fri 06 Mar run. HTX will call with the time.

messages.text_vi: Anh/chị Hộ thửa 1 ơi, thửa F1 còn nước, cứ giữ cống đóng và chờ đợt bơm sau Tue 10 Mar nhé.
messages.text_en: F1 owner: your field still has water, keep the inlet closed and wait for the next run on Tue 10 Mar.

messages.text_vi: Anh Hùng ơi, nhờ anh nói giúp bà Sáu là thửa F3 còn nước, giữ cống đóng và chờ đợt bơm sau Tue 10 Mar nhé.
messages.text_en: HTX officer: please tell Bà Sáu that F3 still has water, so keep the inlet closed and wait for the next run on Tue 10 Mar.
